sentences.en: We often organize social activities to bring people together.
sentences.zh: 我们经常组织社会活动把人们聚集在一起。

sentences.en: Joining in social activities can help you make new friends.
sentences.zh: 参加社会活动可以帮助你结交新朋友。

sentences.en: The company encourages employees to participate in various social activities.
sentences.zh: 公司鼓励员工参与各种社会活动。

senses.zh: 社会活动；社交活动；社会生活
